products.name: Meera Hand-Embroidered Saree
products.description: A six-yard Chanderi saree with a hand-embroidered floral vine running along the pallu. Each bloom is worked in silk floss with a fine gold zari outline — roughly 42 hours of needlework per piece.

products.name: Kutch Mirror-Work Blouse
products.description: Rabari-style mirror work set into a geometric grid, finished with a tie-up back. Made by the Vankar family in Bhujodi.

products.name: Chikankari Cotton Kurti
products.description: Lucknowi chikankari in six classic stitches — bakhiya, murri, phanda, jaali, tepchi and hathkati — on breathable mulmul.

products.name: Phulkari Dupatta
products.description: Punjabi phulkari worked in darning stitch from the reverse of the cloth, so the front reads as a flat field of colour.

products.name: Zardozi Clutch
products.description: A structured evening clutch with dabka and sequin zardozi over raw silk, lined in cotton and closed with a magnetic clasp.

products.name: Kashmiri Aari Stole
products.description: Fine aari hook embroidery in a repeating boteh (paisley) motif, with a hand-knotted fringe along both edges.

products.name: Hoop Art — Monstera Bloom
products.description: A single monstera leaf worked in satin and fishbone stitch, stretched in a 6-inch beech hoop. Ready to hang, no frame needed.

products.name: Hoop Art — Peacock Court
products.description: Two mirrored peacocks in long-and-short stitch with French-knot eyes, ringed by a running-stitch border.

products.name: Cushion Cover — Suzani Garden
products.description: A suzani-style circular vine in chain stitch on heavy cotton canvas, with a concealed zip and piped edge.

products.name: Kantha Table Runner
products.description: Three layers of cotton held together by a field of running stitches — the classic Bengali kantha — with a stitched border.

products.name: Kids' Embroidered Frock
products.description: A gathered cotton frock with lazy-daisy flowers along the yoke, lined at the bodice and finished with wooden buttons.

products.name: Bridal Lehenga — Zardozi Court
products.description: Our heaviest piece: 96 hours of zardozi, dabka and kora work on silk velvet, with a scalloped hem and hand-finished blouse. Made to order in 6–8 weeks.

products.name: Thread & Needle Starter Kit
products.description: 24 skeins of cotton floss, 6 needles, a 5-inch hoop, printed cotton and a stitch dictionary booklet with 12 illustrated stitches.

products.name: Embroidered Potli Bag
products.description: A drawstring potli in brocade with a paisley worked in gold thread and a beaded tassel.

products.name: Peacock Panel Cushion
products.description: A single peacock in silk floss and metallic thread on dupion, mounted as a cushion face with a cotton back.

products.name: Kantha Quilt Throw
products.description: A lightweight throw of layered vintage cotton, quilted with thousands of running stitches in contrasting thread.

reviews.name: Ananya R.
reviews.title: Heirloom quality
reviews.body: The pallu work is finer than anything I have bought in a store. It came wrapped in muslin with a note from the karigar.

reviews.name: Divya M.
reviews.title: Beautiful, slightly heavy
reviews.body: Gorgeous for an evening function. The zari outline makes it a little stiff to drape at first but it softens.

reviews.name: Ritika S.
reviews.title: Perfect for Chennai summers
reviews.body: The mulmul is genuinely breathable and the jaali work does not itch at all. Bought a second one in white.

reviews.name: Kavya N.
reviews.title: Looks lovely on the wall
reviews.body: Smaller than I expected but honestly better for it. The fishbone stitch on the leaf is really neat.

reviews.name: Simran K.
reviews.title: Colours are rich
reviews.body: The reverse side is a lovely mess of thread, exactly how real phulkari should look. Slight colour variation from the photo.

reviews.name: Meghna T.
reviews.title: Stitching is tight and even
reviews.body: Bought two for the living room. The zip is concealed properly and the piping is a nice touch.
